The present petition has been preferred against the ord  whereby the SDO, Ashoknagar had constituted a committee consti  CEO Janpad Panchayat Ashoknagar, Mayank Tiwari Naib Tehsildar   Executive Magistrate, Tehsil Ashoknagar, Shri Shambhu Singh Me  Tehsildar and Exutive Magistrate, Tehsil Ashoknagar, Shri   Gautam Naib Tehsildar and Executive Magistrate, Tehsil Shahdor  Tiwari, Revenue Inspector, Tehsil Ashoknagar, Shri Deepak Ragh  Patwari, Gram Ashoknagar, Shri Santosh Raghuvanshi, Patwari, G  Shri Gaurav Tiwari, Patwari, Gram Sirsi Pachar and Smt. Preksh  Gram Marup and they have been directed with the help of offici  Pradesh Jal Nigam, L & T and SDOP to decide the objections of   persons from whose lands water pipe line under Rajghat Samooh   Yojna which is a flagship scheme of Union of India and State o  passed.
 Learned Counsel for the petitioner had submitted that   opportunity of hearing to the petitioner, water pipe line is b  their agricultural fields which the respondents could not do w the land legally as there is no provision under the scheme which gives them any powers to lay a pipe line through private lands.
It was further submitted that though a committee has been formulated to decide the objections, but it is not competent under the M.P. Land Revenue Code or any other Act to decide the question of acquisition or compensation if any to be paid to the petitioner.

It was further argued that the lay out plan for laying the pipe line firstly had not been published and no objection has been called from the concerned persons and it is not known to any of the petitioner as to what is the actual lay out of the pipe line as earlier the respondents had marked different part of the land but later on when they Aman Kumar Bansal vs State Jal Nigam Maryadit Guna on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6587182/
1 found that the pipe line could not be laid there they had changed the plan on their own without informing the petitioner which is per se illegal.

sentences.text: O n the aforesaid premises
, it has been submitted that the act of the respondents in laying the pipe line without adopting the legal recourse is liable to be stopped.
Thus, it was prayed that the said petition be allowed and the respondents be restrained from laying pipe lines through the lands of the petitioner.

Shri Vivek Khedkar, learned Additional Advocate General and and Shri S . S . Kushwaha - Govt.
Advocate for respondent/State have opposed the prayer made by the Sr. Counsel and it has been submitted that the pipe lines are being laid as per the lay out plan under the Rajghat Samooh Jal Pradai Yojna which is a flagship scheme of Union of India and State of M.P, for the betterment of the residence of the District Ashoknagar and as the pipe line is going through the lands of the present petitioner he is objecting for laying of the said pipe line.

It is further argued that vide Annexure P/1, SDO has constituted a committee before whom the petitioner can raise his objections which would be taken care of and the order impugned also reflects the same.
Thus, it was prayed the present petition be dismissed.
Heard on the question of admission and interim relief.

Prima facie, it appears to this Court that the action taken by the respondents of laying down the pipe line through the lands of the present petitioner under the Rajghat Samooh Jal Pradai Yojna is under which provision is not clear, though this Court is seized of the fact that the said scheme appears to be for the benefit of the residence of Distt. Ashoknagar but the fact remains that the grievance of the private persons i.e. the petitioner herein is also required to be addressed before taking any action.

Thus, keeping this petition pending, the petitioner is directed to raise objections by way of an application before the Collector, Distt. Ashoknagar who shall address upon said objections within a period of seven days, from today.
Till further orders, any work to be carried out on the lands of the present petitioner, under the Rajghat Samooh Jal Pradai Yojna, shall be kept in abeyance.
Issue notice to respondents nos. 1 and 3 on payment of PF within seven working days by RAD as well as ordinary mode.
List the matter on 22.4.2024.
